text_block_list.text:
A few days after they began practicing 
karuta—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "H-H-Here I go!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh! D-Doto-san! If you start sprinting 
so suddenly...!"
(SLAM!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Uuu... *sniff*..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I tripped again 
today... 
This isn't even proper practice anymore, 
I'm so sorry~~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's okay~! Tomorrow you won't trip, 
I'm sure of it! Right?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"But... in the end, I haven't been able to 
grab a single card since we started 
practicing..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I ended up dragging Fukukitaru-san down 
with me when I tripped, and then the card 
I reflexively grabbed flew right at Opera 
O-san and the others..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Now that was quite thrilling! The card 
nearly collided head-on with the face of 
the beautiful Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Rolling around with Ope-chan shouting 
'Look out!' was super fun!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Hauuu~~, I dragged everyone into my 
clumsy mess... I'm really, really sorry 
for being such a nuisance~~."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm like this, who knows what'll 
happen in the real thing... What if we end 
up losing every single match because of my 
clumsiness—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"(I wanted to bring everyone happiness in 
the new year, but if I just end up causing 
trouble with my clumsiness again...)"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... I don't want that to happen...! 
Um... I'm—I'm going to stay behind and 
practice a bit more~~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh?! What's gotten into you all of a 
sudden, D-Doto-saaan?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, how capricious, like a feather 
dancing on the wind... It seems my partner 
has departed."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... In that case, allow me to take my 
leave as well. There are preparations I 
must make for our splendid New Year's 
performance!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? You too, Opera O-san? Aww, come on, 
let's all go back together happily~."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Uh-oh, they're gone."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... I wonder if Doto-san will be okay. 
It's not like we have to win, so I hope 
she isn't brooding over it too much..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Huh? We don't have to win? How come?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, Lord Shiraoki's oracle didn't say 
we absolutely have to win~. With things 
like this, having fun is what matters 
most!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Playing karuta with everyone is 
lots of fun! But that's why I think 
winning would be even more fun!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone would be super happy if we won 
together, right? That's why I wanna win!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hyooeeeee, such pure, straightforward 
ambition! It's blinding—far too 
blinding~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Blinding? Oh, there's shade under that 
tree over there! Wanna go together?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No, don't mind me! ...Anyway, let's head 
back for today. We have practice tomorrow 
too, after all!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Yeah, let's do our best tomorrow too!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"(Winning would be even more fun... huh... 
Urara-san really is amazing...)"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...I wonder if Doto and the others are 
still practicing today...?)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"This past year... I've caused you so much 
trouble with all my clumsy mistakes, 
Ayabe-san... So—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to be happy too, 
Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...\nSorry, but I'll pass."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I should take a short break...

"Ugh... *sniffle*. When I hear the poem... 
I run—!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I can't... crash into anyone. Listen 
carefully to Opera O-san's instructions... 
and then... and then—?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"How should I practice to get better...? 
Ugh... Why am I always so hopeless and 
clumsy...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"B-But I have no choice but to try...! 
O-One more time—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Waaahhh—!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Doto... what are you doing?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... Ayabe-san... U-Um, this is, well... 
independent practice, or special training, 
I suppose...?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I... I'm holding everyone back again... 
Uuu... I really am totally hopeless, 
aren't I...?"
